Hey everyone, hope you have all had a good week!

Just trying to get a gauge as to numbers around transport tomorrow. Please respond to this poll if you are available for the game if you will need a van or not going to the game. The van will come back to college once the first 11 game has finished. 

Cheers, 
Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Game tomorrow is at home vs MAGS, will be a wet pitch so if you have metal stud boots please bring them. 

Be there 9am for a 10am K.O. 

Cheers, let’s get another win 💪💯
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
What a performance today lads, 4 goals, clean sheet and controlled the game incredibly well. Congratulations! 

Enjoy your weekends, parents thank you for all your support! See you all next week at training 👏
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

Game info tomorrow, meet at selwyn changing rooms at 9:00am for a 10:00am ko. 

Huge game against Howick tomorrow, let’s give them a big fight and come away with the win 💪
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Because it suits most people, we will do a 2:30pm-3:45 training tomorrow.

See you all then.

Hey everyone, 

With exams this week, I’m aware the latest exam finishes at 2pm? (Correct me if I’m wrong), would you guys want to do a 2:30pm training time start instead to make it easier for everyone? 

Thumbs up to this message if so!

Thanks

13a.message:
Hi team! Just an update for the 13a rotation. After this week, we will continue with the updated rotation but I have subbed Harry and Pedro in as they have missed out the past couple of weeks due to injury. 

This week the players sitting out will be:

Tom, Max and Liam M vs Mt Roskill Grammar 

Then the rotation will continue as per the updated one I sent out last week. Let me know if you have any questions!
13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message: Thanks Nick, sorry for the late response. We will put Harry and Pedro in this week!
13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message:
Hey team, I’m sorry I am going to have to cancel training this morning. I am very sick. 

See you all Saturday!!
13a.author: Mojtaba Sayed

13a.message:
Hi Team,
Sorry I have a school sports event tomorrow so won’t be able to make training.
Liam
13a.author: Liam McIvor

13a.message:
Hi team. I’m not able to make the game next week as I’ll be on a plane back from Hong Kong still. Sorry. Hopefully, someone else will be able to help with subs and recording the game. 

I think Harry’s rotated out anyway, so hopefully not a problem. I know he’ll be super keen to play, so if you need him then let us know and we’ll see if we can work out how to get him there.
13a.author: Nick Mackeson-Smith

13a.message:
Hey lads, 
I know the result didn’t go our way, but I feel like we were the better team. However that’s not how football works the best team doesn’t always win. Hope you don’t see this as a loss but as a learning opportunity. Proud of the efforts by everyone but just need to work on some things. 

See you all Tuesday!!
13a.author: Mojtaba Sayed

13a.message: Cool. I’ll let him know
13a.author: Nick Mackeson-Smith

13a.message: Upto him really! The 14b team will be playing same time on the front field if he feels like having a run around with them?
13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message: Hiya. Yep - he seems to be ok now. He’s rested it well and he’s all back to normal. Happy to take him wherever you want him to be. Cheers.
13a.author: Nick Mackeson-Smith

13a.message: Hey Nick, how is Harry’s knee? He emailed me yesterday saying he is able to play now? That’s great news! I probably can’t change the stand down list now for tomorrow but if Harry wants to bring his gear I’m sure he could get on for a run around…? I will put him back in the team for next week!

13a.message:
Hey everyone, 
Just a quick message about footballs. We have lost about a dozen balls this season already and we won’t be buying any more. 
Can you please make sure that when you use the bags of balls, the same number of balls are in the bag at the end of training. If you combine 2 bags, can you please make sure that the correct balls are put back in the correct bags. There should be 8 balls in most bags. If you lose any or they go over a fence just let us know so we can try to get them back. 
Thanks! 😊
